title: My Brother-In-Law Begged Me To Pay His $95K Mortgage, Then Evicted Me. So I Now Own His Farm.
description: When my brother-in-law begged me to pay off his $95K mortgage, I thought we had a deal: a life estate and the farm inheritance. Instead, he refinanced, sold the whole place, and handed me a $10,000 check with a 30-day eviction notice. I took him to court with a video promise, the sale was voided, and now I own the farm, lease the back acres to a pumpkin patch called 'Gourd of Deceit,' and make him work the register in a scarecrow costume. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY HOME. NOW HE SERVES LATTES IN A SCARECROW SUIT.
pinned_comment: After paying off his $95K mortgage, what would you do if your brother-in-law gave you a $10,000 check and a 30-day eviction notice? Share your own revenge stories in the comments.
